visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Node Is Not Printed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list 5, 6, 7 should be printed completely, but the last element 7 is missing.

solution.explanation: To visit every node the loop must continue while p itself is not NULL. Testing p->next stops at the last node before printing it. (That test is the right one when you want to stop at the last node, as append does.)
